notes.title: Gameplay polish + small roundup on public events
notes.notes:
Hello!

Here's a quick roundup on discussions & videos that feature Levaluhta & our devs, from the last few months:

[b]Why The Future Of Horror Games Is Indie | The Glass House Games Show - Ft. Xalavier Nelson Jr[/b]
[previewyoutube=2Rs6smFL0Yg;full][/previewyoutube]
..is a legit interesting discussion on the state of horror games, and what the future might bring. There's also a quick glimpse of Levaluhta & our dear Jussi..!

[b]EEK3 2021 Indie Horror Showcase[/b]
[previewyoutube=L10LJUmgi08;full][/previewyoutube]
..is the best online presentation of upcoming indie horror, all around. Featuring many interesting, cool games. Including you-know-what..!

[b]LittFest Etkot: Leväluhta – kirjasta peliksi. Marko Hautala, Riina Peltonen & Henri Tervapuro[/b]
[previewyoutube=sb3xOgyUlyo;full][/previewyoutube]
..is a finnish discussion between Marko Hautala (author of Leväluhta, horror novel), Riina Peltonen (author of Noitia, kalloja ja vedenhenkiä. A Non-fiction writer specialising into magic, history and folklore), and our dear Henri (Tervapuro, lead developer of Levaluhta the game).


We've also conducted cold testing on the game, and based on feedback & analysis, we're polishing the interactions / UX experience. After all, one of our biggest principles is to make the game feel smooth and satisfying.

notes.title: Chapter 1 DONE + new trailer
notes.notes:
Hello lovelies,

Good news! We've finished Chapter 1 out of 4..!
That takes care of the story setup and introducing everything... based on private test rounds, we're doing something really really good here. And also, now its the time for polishing, bugfixes, etc... 
Also! There's no set date yet, but we're planning on a public demo for Q1 / Q2 next year, how do you like THEM apples..?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218325/6194ae1e3945179a6a62d5f7bac1444459f54bc7.gif[/img]


[b]For the occasion of #PitchYaGame over in Twitter, we've cut a new trailer.. remember to put the sounds on, share and like![/b] 

[url=https://twitter.com/levaluhta/status/1455532219657768982]twitter.com/levaluhta/status/1455532219657768982[/url]

Take care and cyas later!
Henri,
Platonic Partnership
